items.title: Wheat Grain in a Hand Sieve
items.alt: A round wooden-handled mesh sieve holds golden wheat kernels and pale chaff, with a few loose grains below.
items.description: A round wooden-handled mesh sieve holds golden wheat kernels and pale chaff, with a few loose grains below. The mesh, kernels and chaff suit an illustration of grain cleaning.

items.title: Hand-Crank Wheat Mill
items.alt: A tabletop grain mill has a wooden wheat-filled hopper, a side crank and a low bowl collecting flour beneath its outlet.
items.description: A tabletop grain mill has a wooden wheat-filled hopper, a side crank and a low bowl collecting flour beneath its outlet. Place this compact mill beside your own notes about turning grain into flour.

items.title: Millstones and Wheat Grain
items.alt: Two circular grooved millstones sit beside ripe wheat heads, loose kernels and a small mound of flour.
items.description: Two circular grooved millstones sit beside ripe wheat heads, loose kernels and a small mound of flour. The exposed grooves and central opening suit a historical grain-processing display.

items.title: Wheat Flour in a Wooden Scoop
items.alt: A broad wooden scoop holds pale wheat flour beside a small spill, two golden wheat heads and loose kernels.
items.description: A broad wooden scoop holds pale wheat flour beside a small spill, two golden wheat heads and loose kernels. Add the scoop to a personal baking ingredient card without obscuring the flour detail.

items.title: Wheat Bran in a Bowl
items.alt: A shallow cream ceramic bowl holds tan wheat bran flakes beside a wooden spoon and ripe wheat heads.
items.description: A shallow cream ceramic bowl holds tan wheat bran flakes beside a wooden spoon and ripe wheat heads. Use the visible papery flakes when illustrating a grain-products vocabulary activity.

items.title: Cracked Wheat in a Glass Jar
items.alt: An open glass jar holds coarse cracked wheat beside its wooden lid, a filled wooden spoon and one ripe wheat head.
items.description: An open glass jar holds coarse cracked wheat beside its wooden lid, a filled wooden spoon and one ripe wheat head. The transparent jar and loose pieces suit a pantry ingredient card.
